title: NSE Indices Launches 'Nifty 500 Ahimsa Index' (326 Animal-Cruelty-Free Stocks)
summary: India's 1st animal-cruelty-free thematic stock market index based on AIM framework.

blocks.content: India's 1st animal-cruelty-free thematic stock market index based on AIM framework.

items: Index Composition: 326 stocks selected from Nifty 500 universe using Ahimsa Investment Movement (AIM) Green-band screening.
Base Date & CAGR: Base date April 1, 2016 (base value 1,000); delivered 15.11% CAGR since inception.
